info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Status API allows consumers to retrieve the current status of ongoing food delivery orders. This endpoint provides insights into delivery progress, estimated arrival times, and any potential delays. Businesses such as restaurants and delivery services can use this API to enhance customer experience by providing real-time updates. Typical use cases include user notifications, tracking systems, and order management platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status updates for deliveries, providing information on their current state and estimated time of arrival.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the status of deliveries. It expects a JSON payload that adheres to the specified schema for operations related to retrieving delivery statuses.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of deliveries.
